name: skill-orchestrator
description: Turn a screenplay and references into one sealed visual asset, an expert-reviewed visual spec, and one evidence-bound Chinese OpenAI image prompt.

interface.shortDescription: From a full screenplay to one controlled visual asset and prompt.
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first visual-development pipeline for Codex. It analyzes a screenplay, limits user references to declared responsibilities, seals exactly one character, environment, scene state, or hero prop, and coordinates independent experts through a recoverable DAG. Three confirmation gates protect intent before one Chinese OpenAI-first master prompt is written. It does not generate images, model parameters, a separate negative prompt, or a second asset.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $screenplay-concept-director to analyze my screenplay and seal exactly one visual asset, stopping at every confirmation gate. After the requirement is sealed, use $image-prompt-team to produce one confirmed visual specification and one Chinese OpenAI-first master prompt without generating an image.
